diaspora_bullets: First Indian woman to win Masters-2 gold at the championship
Coached by video call after her coach's US visa was denied
key_entities: World Masters Classic and Equipped Powerlifting Championships
news_summary: IRS officer Ekta Vishnoi won three gold medals at the World Masters Classic and Equipped Powerlifting Championships in Nevada, lifting a combined 362.5 kg.
payoff: She took up powerlifting at 45 — seven years later she is a world Masters champion.
